answer: Histories are stored in opal, checked in pulse, and ember publishes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 17 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 610 identities would post 2831 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
